description: Elimination of Rabies and Registration of Dogs Bill
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-06-30 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Approval has been granted at the Cabinet meeting held on 2025-09-22 to prepare a Bill to consolidate the Rabies Ordinance (Chapter 476) and the Dog Registration Ordinance (Chapter 477) with the objective of controlling the dog population, regularizing and making mandatory the administration of rabies vaccination for dogs, strengthening legal provisions relating to the registration of dogs, clarifying the powers and responsibilities of the institutions responsible for those functions, and establishing a mechanism for the implementation of those responsibilities. Accordingly, the clearance of the Attorney General has been received for the Elimination of Rabies and Registration of Dogs Bill prepared by the Legal Draftsman. The proposal made by the Minister of Public Administration, Provincial Councils and Local Government to publish the said Bill in the Government Gazette and thereafter submit the same to Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.
